claims.evidence: 30 sources = one per (SILAC mix, channel): mixes 1-6 are triplex (3 channels), 7a-7c and 8a-8c duplex (2 channels) per Labellingscheme.xlsx; each source is one labelled culture lysate in one mix, so no name denotes two physical samples. Sample ids 1..8c = MaxQuant Experiment names 24h_1..48h_8c.

Data check (channel_check.txt): summed intensity of 350 Chlamydia-only protein groups is highest, by 6-15x, in exactly the Ctr-infected channel of all 12 mixes; CPPED1 (paper: strongly down in E6E7) is highest and LCP1 (paper: up in E6E7) lowest in exactly the pWPI channel of all 6 triplex mixes. No conflict.

Human oral keratinocytes; the HPV16 and C. trachomatis proteins are pathogen/transgene proteins in the human sample, not separate organisms of the sample (they are in the search database only).

Paper: "immortalized human keratinocytes (normal oral keratinocytes [NOKs]) (29)"; keratinocytes of the oral cavity form the oral epithelium. Inferred from the cell type + origin; the exact oral site is not stated.
Paper and PRIDE organismParts CL:0000312 Keratinocyte.

NOKs are normal oral keratinocytes, spontaneously immortalized; HPV16 E6E7 transduction and C. trachomatis infection are experimental manipulations recorded in their own columns. PRIDE diseases "cervix carcinoma" is the study motivation, not a property of these cells (reconcile exit 0).
Immortalized NOK cell line.
Paper (Materials summary): "Immortalized female human oral keratinocytes stably expressing the HPV16 oncogenes".

claims.value: NOK (normal oral keratinocytes, Piboonniyom et al. 2002)
claims.evidence: Paper cites ref 29 Piboonniyom SO, Timmermann S, Hinds P, Munger K, Oral Oncol 2002 (PMID 11854066) for the NOKs. Cellosaurus has no entry for this line (no hit for PMID 11854066); id:NOK returns only mouse hybridomas NOK-1..NOK-5 (CVCL_E4A6..E4AA) and the unrelated, male, HaCaT-contaminated NOK-SI (CVCL_BW57). The value is therefore disambiguated with the originating publication.
No Cellosaurus entry for the Munger-lab NOK line; NOK-SI (CVCL_BW57) is a different line and deliberately not used.

limitations: characteristics[culture medium] = not available: the SILAC medium is "FAD" (75% Ham's F-12 + 25% DMEM for SILAC, 5% FBS, insulin, EGF, cholera toxin, adenine, hydrocortisone; paper Cell culture / Cell labeling sections). NCIT (the column's ontology) has no term for FAD or Ham's F-12 medium; a free-text value failed parse_sdrf validation in round 1 (ERROR "not a valid ontology term"), and DMEM alone would misdescribe it.

characteristics[cellosaurus accession]/[cellosaurus name] = not available: the NOK line (Piboonniyom et al. 2002, Munger lab) has no Cellosaurus record; the cell-line value is disambiguated from the mouse hybridomas NOK-1..5 and from NOK-SI (CVCL_BW57) by naming the originating publication. parse_sdrf warns that this free-text cell line is not in CLO/BTO/EFO (warning only).

characteristics[age], [developmental stage], [ancestry category], [individual], [passage number] = not available: donor age/ancestry are not given in the paper or ref 29 as retrieved; passage only as "within 10 passages after selection" (not a number).
characteristics[organism part] "oral epithelium" is inferred from "normal oral keratinocytes"; the exact oral site of the donor tissue is not stated.

Biological-replicate numbering assumes the pWPI uninfected cultures of part 2 (mixes 7a-c/8a-c) are distinct from those of part 1 (mixes 1-3/4-6). PRIDE calls part 2 a separate experiment and the scheme lists them as separate samples, but no source states explicitly that new cultures were grown; if they were the same lysates, those numbers would collapse to 1-3.

Chlamydia trachomatis strain/serovar and MOI are not stated in PRIDE or the paper (the mSphere paper analyses only the uninfected E6E7 vs pWPI comparison; the infection arms are described only in the PRIDE record and Labellingscheme.xlsx). Hence only the species is encoded.

Uninfected channels show a residual ~5-15% Chlamydia protein signal relative to the infected channel of the same mix (MaxQuant requantify / ratio compression); it does not change the channel assignment.
